question: Orion Freight Systems is asking for a refund 45 days after their renewal. Are they eligible, and who must approve it?
expected_answer: Yes. Orion is eligible for a pro-rata refund of the remaining term under clause 7.3 of its MSA: Orbisa missed the 99.9% Uptime SLA in August 2026 (99.33%, incidents INC-2291 and INC-2304), inside the 60 days after the 2026-08-15 renewal, and the request came on day 45, within the 60-day window. The standard POL-007 v2 policy alone would not allow it (14-day window), and the 2023 30-day rule no longer applies. The refund must be approved by Tomás Herrera, Head of RevOps, not by Finance.
expected_facts: MSA clause 7.3 gives a pro-rata refund within 60 days of a renewal date if the SLA is missed in that period
August 2026 uptime was 99.33%, below the 99.9% SLA
Standard POL-007 v2 allows a full refund only within 14 days
Refunds are approved by RevOps (Tomás Herrera) since 2026-03-03
trap: Using the 2023 30-day policy (not eligible, Finance approves) or the Brisklane 60-day rule (wrong reason).

question: Who approves customer refunds at Orbisa?
expected_answer: RevOps: Tomás Herrera, Head of RevOps, approves every refund since 2026-03-03. Finance only processes the payout after RevOps approves.
trap: Confluence 'Revenue Team — Roles' still says Finance (Priya Raman).

question: Who approves customer refunds at Orbisa?
expected_answer: Finance: the CFO, Priya Raman, under Refund Policy v1 (POL-007, 2023). The move to RevOps only happened on 2026-03-03.
expected_facts: On 2025-12-01 refunds were approved by Finance (CFO Priya Raman)
trap: Answering with today's rule (RevOps) and ignoring the as-of date.

question: A support agent told Orion that refunds are only possible within 30 days of renewal. Is that correct?
expected_answer: No. The 30-day rule is the 2023 Refund Policy (POL-007 v1), replaced on 2026-03-01 by POL-007 v2: full refund within 14 days of renewal, service credits after that, and signed contract terms win. Orion's MSA clause 7.3 gives an SLA-based pro-rata refund right within 60 days of renewal.
expected_facts: POL-007 v2 is effective since 2026-03-01 with a 14-day window
Contract terms override the standard policy
trap: The 2023 page is still live in Confluence and was never archived.

question: What service credit is Orion entitled to for August 2026 under the SLA policy?
expected_answer: 10% of the monthly fee, which is USD 1,550 (10% of USD 15,500), because August uptime was 99.33%, between 99.0% and 99.9%. Orion must request it within 30 days after the end of August. If Orion gets a clause 7.3 refund for the same month, the refund replaces the credit.
expected_facts: Credit is 10% of the monthly fee
Request within 30 days of month end
trap: Using 25% (that tier is for uptime below 99.0%).

expected_answer: Both the CEO, Marina Costa, and the CFO, Priya Raman. Since 2026-06-15 any discount above 20% needs CEO and CFO sign-off. The Confluence Discount Approval Matrix (CFO only) is outdated.

expected_answer: Yes. Bluefin is on Orbisa standard terms and asked on 2026-10-13, 10 days after the 2026-10-03 renewal, so POL-007 v2 gives a full refund (within 14 days) of the annual fee, USD 28,800. RevOps (Tomás Herrera) must approve; the ticket #48251 is escalated and not yet approved.

expected_answer: Cedar & Pine is a Brisklane legacy customer. They asked on 2026-03-05, day 32 after the 2026-02-01 renewal. POL-007 v2 explicitly keeps Brisklane terms for legacy contracts. Tomás Herrera (RevOps) approved it on 2026-03-06.
expected_facts: Brisklane terms: full refund within 60 days

question: What caused the August 27, 2026 tracking outage and how long did it last?
expected_answer: INC-2304: the TLS certificate on the carrier-webhook gateway expired because automatic renewal had been disabled during a July migration. It lasted 1 hour 47 minutes (06:40–08:27 UTC).
expected_facts: Expired TLS certificate on the carrier-webhook gateway

question: What caused INC-2291?
expected_answer: Release v4.12 of the tracking-ingest service changed the Kafka consumer batch size; consumers fell behind and the Track API returned 503 for 3 hours 12 minutes on 2026-08-19. It was fixed by rolling back to v4.11.
